meta.name: Pramaan Commissioning Risk Graph
meta.what: A directed knowledge graph: deviation-class -> commissioning-test -> Cx-level -> integration milestone. Every edge carries the failure mode it predicts and the governing standard that grounds the mapping. This is the structure behind the 'commissioning risk twin' — not a flat lookup; nodes and edges are independently citable and the graph is traversable and extensible.
meta.level_taxonomy_basis: ASHRAE Guideline 0-2019 (The Commissioning Process) and Guideline 1.1; BICSI-002 data-centre commissioning levels L1-L5; Uptime Institute Tier Certification of Constructed Facility (integrated-systems / fault-tolerance demonstration).

1.name: Factory / component verification (FAT, receipt)
1.basis: BICSI-002 L1; ASHRAE Gdl 0 component verification

2.name: Site acceptance / installation verification
2.basis: BICSI-002 L2; ASHRAE Gdl 0 installation checks

4.name: Functional performance testing under load / failover
4.basis: BICSI-002 L4; ASHRAE Gdl 0 functional performance testing

5.name: Integrated systems test (pull-the-plug, sustained ops)
5.basis: BICSI-002 L5; Uptime Tier IV fault-tolerance demonstration
